senses.gloss: m. (נְקַר I, cmp. קוֹר I) [pickings,] marrow, brain (v. מוֹחָא).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 21:24">Targ. Job XXI, 24</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:28">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 28</cite> <he>דמטפשא מ׳</he> (not <cite ref="M00582"><he>מוקדא</he></cite>) which makes the brain fat (dulls man’s reason, v. <cite ref="I00681"><he>טְפַשׁ</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Chullin 93a:10">Ḥull. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>דביעי ודמ׳</he> the membrane covering the testicles and that covering the brain.—

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 111">Yalk. Gen. 111</cite>, end; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64">Gen. R. s. 64</cite>, end <he>מוקריה</he> some ed., v. <cite ref="M02400"><he>מַקּוֹרָא</he></cite>.]—V. <cite ref="M00583"><he>מוֹקְדָא</he> II</cite>.
